description: This file contains functions and classes for managing Docker sandbox backends, including creating, configuring, running commands, and describing Docker containers within a sandbox environment.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredDockerRuntimeImage
methods.description: Determines the Docker image to use based on configuration label kind.

methods.name: createDockerSandboxBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Docker sandbox backend handle.

methods.name: createDockerSandboxBackendHandle
methods.description: Constructs a sandbox backend handle object with methods for executing commands and running shells.

methods.name: runDockerSandboxShellCommand
methods.description: Executes a shell command inside a Docker container using 'docker exec'.
